description: This file implements the Dictionary class for a language input method, providing functionalities such as suggestion retrieval, word addition, validation, and traversal of a trie-based dictionary structure. It is part of an Android input method project, specifically related to a Japanese dictionary version 2.

classes.name: nativeime::Dictionary
classes.description: A class managing a trie-based dictionary for language suggestions, including methods for suggestion generation, word validation, and internal data management.

methods.name: getSuggestions
methods.description: Generates word suggestions based on input codes, populating output buffers with candidate words and their frequencies.

methods.name: registerNextLetter
methods.description: Registers the frequency of a next possible letter following the current input context.

methods.name: getChar
methods.description: Retrieves a character from the dictionary data at a given position, handling 16-bit codes.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Retrieves an address (offset) within the dictionary data, decoding based on flags.

methods.name: getFreq
methods.description: Retrieves the frequency value associated with a word or node.

methods.name: wideStrLen
methods.description: Calculates the length of a wide-character string.

methods.name: addWord
methods.description: Adds a new word to the dictionary, maintaining sorted order based on frequency and length.

methods.name: sameAsTyped
methods.description: Checks if a given word matches the typed input codes.

methods.name: getWordsRec
methods.description: Recursively traverses the dictionary trie to find candidate words matching input criteria.

methods.name: checkFirstCharacter
methods.description: Checks if a word starts with the same or neighboring characters as the input.

methods.name: isValidWord
methods.description: Validates whether a word exists in the dictionary, considering capitalization variations.

methods.name: countWordsHelper
methods.description: Counts total words and their character lengths in the dictionary trie.

methods.name: isValidWordRec
methods.description: Recursively checks if a word exists in the dictionary trie.
